name: YT2TXT — Video to Transcript
description: Extract transcripts from YouTube and any yt-dlp supported site. Uses AI transcription when native subtitles are unavailable.
_host_permissions_note: Wildcard ports are intentional — the backend port is user-configurable and can be any port on localhost. Restricting to specific ports would break setups using non-default ports.

get-transcript.description: Get transcript for the current page
